children: New Delhi, Nov. 1 -- Dividend, bonus, split, buyback in November: The second-last month of the year 2026 has begun and it all set to be an action-packed month for investors who closely track corporate actions like dividend, stock split, bonus, rights issue, etc.
Coal India, Hindustan Unilever, Power Grid Corporation of India, and Infosys Limited are among the top companies that have fixed record dates for different corporate actions in November.

Apart from corporate actions in November, investors will also closely track whether the Indian stock market retains its recovery or sees another dip. Nifty 50 gained 2.81% in one month, whereas BSE Sensex gained 3.55% during October. Here are all the details about upcoming dividend, bonus, split, buyback, rights issue record date, as per BSE website data on November 1.

Colgate Palmolive, Pitti Engineering Limited, Infosys, Gravita India, Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders, Asian Paints, Coal India, Godrej Consumer Products, Engineers India Ltd, etc have fixed record dates for dividend in November.
Three companies have fixed record dates for stock split corporate action. Gujarat Natural Resources has fixed November 5 as the record date for the stock split from Rs.10 to Re 1.

Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Limited has fixed November 6 as the record date for stock split from Rs.5 to Re 1. Whereas, Interarch Building Solutions Limited has fixed November 30 as the record date for stock split from Rs.10 to Rs.2.

FDC Limited and Medi Assist Healthcare Services have fixed record dates in November for buy back of shares. FDS has fixed November 13, whereas Medi Assist Healthcare Services has fixed November 20 as record date.
Crescentis Capital, Suvidhaa Infoserve, and Kanel Industries are the three companies have fixed record dates in November for right issue of equity shares.

A total of five companies have fixed record dates in November for Income Distribution (InvIT) and Income Distribution REITs. InvIT is the distribution of a portion of earnings, profits, or interest to its security holder.

Concord Biotech is the only company that has fixed bonus issue record date in November, as per BSE data as of Nov 1. The company's board of directors approved a bonus issue in the ratio of 1:1. It has fixed Wednesday, November 4, as the record date to determine eligibility of shareholders for the payout.
